meta.product: ILOSTAT EIP TEIP: Persons outside the labour force by sex and age
meta.coverage: Persons outside the labour force by sex and age. PC - Population Census, annual
meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: As published in ILOSTAT from: PC - Population Census.
sourceNotes: Geographical coverage: Total national, excluding some areas (51 obs.)
Reference group coverage: Nonstandard coverage of employed and/or unemployed persons (51 obs.)
Nonstandard age group: Including ages 45-49 (9 obs.)
Nonstandard age group: Including ages 55-59 (9 obs.)
Nonstandard age group: Including ages 65-69 (6 obs.)
Nonstandard age group: Including ages 65+ (3 obs.)
